verses.text: For di eighth month, for di second year of Darius, di Lord word come to Zechariah, di pikin of Berechiah, di pikin of Iddo, di prophet, and e talk say,
“Di Lord dey very displeased with una papa dem.”
“So tell dem, di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Return to me,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘and I go return to una,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”

“No be like una papa dem, wey di former prophets proclaim to, say: Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Return now from una evil ways, and from una evil doings;’ but dem no hear, and dem no listen to me,” na so di Lord talk.
“Una papa dem, wia dem dey? And di prophets, dem dey live forever?”

“But my words and my decrees, wey I command my servants di prophets, dem no overtake una papa dem? Den dem repent and talk say, ‘Just as di Lord of Armies decide to do to us, according to our ways, and according to our deeds, so e don deal with us.’”
For di 24th day of di 11th month, wey na di month Shebat, for di second year of Darius, di Lord word come to Zechariah, di pikin of Berechiah, di pikin of Iddo, di prophet, and e talk say,
I see for night, and look, man dey ride red horse, and e stand among di myrtle trees wey dey for di bottom; and red, brown, and white horses dey behind am.
Den I ask, “My oga, wetin be dem?” Di angel wey dey talk with me talk say to me, “I go show you wetin dem be.”
Di man wey stand among di myrtle trees answer, “Na dem wey di Lord don send to walk go and come through di earth.”
Dem answer di angel of di Lord wey stand among di myrtle trees, and talk say, “We don walk go and come through di earth, and look, all di earth dey rest, and e quiet.”
Den di angel of di Lord reply, “Di Lord of Armies, how long you no go get mercy on Jerusalem and on di cities of Judah, wey you don dey angry with dem for dis 70 years?”
Di Lord answer di angel wey dey talk with me with kind words, even comforting words.
So di angel wey dey talk with me talk say to me, “Proclaim, say, ‘Di Lord of Armies talk say: I dey jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with great jealousy.’”
“‘I dey very angry with di nations wey dey at ease; because I dey only small displeased, and dem add to di calamity.’”
“So di Lord talk say, ‘I don return to Jerusalem with mercy. My house go build inside am,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘and dem go stretch line over Jerusalem.’”
“Proclaim further, say, ‘Di Lord of Armies talk say: My cities go overflow with prosperity again, and di Lord go comfort Zion again, and go choose Jerusalem again.’”
I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, four horns.
I ask di angel wey dey talk with me, “Wetin be dem?” E answer me, “Na dem be di horns wey don scatter Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
Di Lord show me four craftsmen.

Den I ask, “Wetin dem dey come do?” E talk say, “Na dem be di horns wey scatter Judah, so tay nobody lift up im head; but dis ones don come to terrify dem, to cast down di horns of di nations, wey lift up dem horn against di land of Judah to scatter am.”
I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, man wey get measuring line for im hand.
Den I ask, “Wia you dey go?” E talk say to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see wetin be im width and wetin be im length.”
Look, di angel wey dey talk with me step out, and another angel come out to meet am,
and talk say to am, “Run, talk to dis young man, say, ‘Jerusalem go dey inhabited like villages without walls, because of di plenty men and livestock wey dey inside am.’”
“‘Because I,’ na so di Lord talk, ‘go be wall of fire around am, and I go be di glory inside am.’”
“Come! Come! Run from di land of di north,” na so di Lord talk; “because I don spread una abroad like di four winds of di sky,” na so di Lord talk.
“Come, Zion! Escape, you wey dey live with Babylon daughter.”
Because dis na wetin di Lord of Armies talk say: “After glory e don send me to di nations wey plunder you; because di one wey touch you dey touch di apple of im eye.”
“Because look, I go shake my hand over dem, and dem go be plunder to dem wey serve dem; and you go know say di Lord of Armies don send me.”
“Sing and rejoice, Zion daughter; because look, I dey come, and I go live inside you,” na so di Lord talk.
“Plenty nations go join demself to di Lord for dat day, and dem go be my people; and I go live inside you, and you go know say di Lord of Armies don send me to you.”
“Di Lord go inherit Judah as im portion for di holy land, and go choose Jerusalem again.”
“Keep quiet, all flesh, before di Lord; because e don rouse imself from im holy habitation.”
E show me Joshua di high priest dey stand before di angel of di Lord, and Satan dey stand for im right hand to be im adversary.
Di Lord talk say to Satan, “Make di Lord rebuke you, Satan! Yes, make di Lord wey don choose Jerusalem rebuke you! No be dis one na burning stick wey dem pluck out from di fire?”
Now Joshua dey wear filthy garments, and e dey stand before di angel.
E answer and talk say to dem wey dey stand before am, “Remove di filthy garments from am.” E talk say to am, “Look, I don make your iniquity pass from you, and I go clothe you with rich clothes.”
I talk say, “Make dem put clean turban for im head.” So dem put clean turban for im head, and clothe am; and di angel of di Lord dey stand near.
Di angel of di Lord declare to Joshua,

“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘If you go walk inside my ways, and if you go follow my instructions, den you go also judge my house, and go also keep my courts, and I go give you place to walk among dem wey dey stand near.’”
“‘Hear now, Joshua di high priest, you and your fellows wey dey sit before you; because dem na men wey be sign; because look, I go bring out my servant, di Branch.’”

“‘Because look, di stone wey I don set before Joshua; for one stone seven eyes dey; look, I go engrave im engraving,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘and I go remove di iniquity of dat land for one day.’”
“‘For dat day,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘una go invite every man im neighbor under di vine and under di fig tree.’”
Di angel wey dey talk with me come again, and wake me, like man wey dem wake from im sleep.

E talk say to me, “Wetin you see?” I talk say, “I don look, and look, lamp stand wey all na gold, with im bowl for di top of am, and im seven lamps for am; seven pipes dey for each of di lamps, wey dey for di top of am;”
“And two olive trees dey by am, one for di right side of di bowl, and di other for im left side.”
I ask di angel wey dey talk with me, and talk say, “Wetin be dem, my oga?”
Den di angel wey dey talk with me answer me, “You no know wetin dem be?” I talk say, “No, my oga.”
Den e answer me, “Dis na di word of di Lord to Zerubbabel, say, ‘E no be by might, and e no be by power, but by my Spirit,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“Who be you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you na plain; and e go bring out di capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to am.’”
Again di Lord word come to me, and e talk say,
“Di hands of Zerubbabel don lay di foundation of dis house. Im hands go also finish am; and you go know say di Lord of Armies don send me to you.”

“Because who don despise di day of small things? Because dis seven go rejoice, and go see di plumb line for di hand of Zerubbabel. Dem na di eyes of di Lord, wey dey run go and come through all di earth.”
Den I ask am, “Wetin be dis two olive trees for di right side of di lamp stand and for im left side?”
I ask am di second time, “Wetin be dis two olive branches, wey dey beside di two golden spouts, wey pour di golden oil out from demself?”
E answer me, “You no know wetin dem be?” I talk say, “No, my oga.”
Den e talk say, “Dem na di two anointed ones, wey dey stand by Lord of di whole earth.”
Den again I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, flying scroll.
E talk say to me, “Wetin you see?” I answer, “I see flying scroll; im length na 20 cubits, and im width na ten cubits.”

Den e talk say to me, “Dis na di curse wey dey go out over di surface of di whole land; because everyone wey steal go dey cut off from one side according to am; and, everyone wey swear go dey cut off from di other side according to am.”

“I go send am out,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “and e go enter inside di house of di thief, and inside di house of di one wey swear falsely by my name; and e go remain inside im house, and go consume am with im timber and im stones.”
Den di angel wey dey talk with me come out, and talk say to me, “Lift up your eyes now, and see wetin dis one be wey dey come out.”
I talk say, “Wetin e be?” E talk say, “Dis na di ephah basket wey dey come out.” E still talk say, “Dis na dem appearance through all di land,”
“And look, dem lift up lead cover; and dis na woman wey dey sit inside di ephah basket.”
E talk say, “Dis na Wickedness;” and e throw am down inside di ephah basket; and e put di weight of lead for im mouth.
Den I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, two women come out, and wind dey inside dem wings; because dem get wings like di wings of stork; and dem lift up di ephah basket between earth and di sky.
Den I ask di angel wey dey talk with me, “Wia dem dey carry di ephah basket go?”
E talk say to me, “To build house for am for di land of Shinar. When e don ready, dem go set am for dat place for im own place.”
Again I lift up my eyes, and see, and look, four chariots come out from between two mountains; and di mountains na mountains of brass.
For di first chariot red horses dey; and for di second chariot black horses;
And for di third chariot white horses; and for di fourth chariot dappled strong horses.
Den I answer di angel wey dey talk with me, “Wetin be dem, my oga?”
Di angel answer me, “Dem na di four winds of di sky, wey dey go out from standing before Lord of all di earth.”
“Di chariot with di black horses dey go out toward di north country; and di white ones don go out after dem; and di dappled ones don go out toward di south country.”
Di strong ones come out, and dem seek to go so that dem go walk go and come through di earth. E talk say, “Go, walk go and come through di earth!” So dem walk go and come through di earth.
Den e call me, and e talk say to me, “Look, dem wey dey go toward di north country don quiet my spirit for di north country.”
Di Lord word come to me, and e talk say,
“Take from dem wey dey for captivity, even from Heldai, from Tobijah, and from Jedaiah; and come di same day, and enter di house of Josiah, di pikin of Zephaniah, wia dem don come from Babylon;”
“Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set dem on di head of Joshua, di pikin of Jehozadak, di high priest.”
“Talk to am, say, ‘Di Lord of Armies talk say: Look, di man wey im name na di Branch: and e go grow up from im place; and e go build di temple of di Lord;’”
“‘Even e go build di temple of di Lord; and e go carry di glory, and go sit and rule for im throne; and e go be priest for im throne; and di counsel of peace go dey between di two of dem.’”
“Di crowns go belong to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen, di pikin of Zephaniah, for memorial for di temple of di Lord.”
“Dem wey dey far away go come and build for di temple of di Lord, and una go know say di Lord of Armies don send me to una. Dis go happen, if una go carefully obey di voice of di Lord una God.”
For di fourth year of king Darius, di Lord word come to Zechariah for di fourth day of di ninth month, even for Chislev.
Now di people of Bethel don send Sharezer and Regemmelech, and dem men, to entreat di favor of di Lord,
and to talk to di priests of di house of di Lord of Armies, and to di prophets, and talk say, “I suppose weep for di fifth month, dey separate myself, as I don do dis plenty years?”
Den di word of di Lord of Armies come to me, and e talk say,
“Talk to all di people of di land, and to di priests, say, ‘When una fast and mourn for di fifth and for di seventh month, even dis 70 years, una fast to me at all, truly to me?’”
“‘When una eat, and when una drink, una no dey eat for una own selves, and drink for una own selves?’”
“‘No be dis na di words wey di Lord proclaim through di former prophets, when Jerusalem dey inhabited and e dey prosper, and im cities around am, and di South and di lowland dey inhabited?’”
Di Lord word come to Zechariah, and e talk say,
“Dis na wetin di Lord of Armies don talk, say, ‘Do true judgment, and show kindness and compassion, every man to im brother.’”
“‘No oppress di widow, or di fatherless, di foreigner, or di poor; and make nobody among una plan evil against im brother inside una heart.’”
But dem refuse to listen, and turn dem backs, and block dem ears, so that dem no go hear.
Yes, dem make dem hearts hard like flint, rather than to listen to di law and di words wey di Lord of Armies send by im Spirit through di former prophets. So great wrath come from di Lord of Armies.
“E don happen say, as e call, and dem refuse to listen, so dem go call, and I no go listen,” na so di Lord of Armies talk;
“But I go scatter dem with whirlwind among all di nations wey dem never know. So di land dey desolate after dem, so tay nobody pass through or return; because dem make di pleasant land desolate.”
Di word of di Lord of Armies come to me, and e talk say,
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘I dey jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I dey jealous for am with great wrath.’”
“Di Lord talk say, ‘I don return to Zion, and I go live inside Jerusalem. Dem go call Jerusalem Di City of Truth; and di mountain of di Lord of Armies, Di Holy Mountain.’”
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Old men and old women go dey live again for di streets of Jerusalem, every man with im staff for im hand because of old age.’”
“‘Di streets of di city go full with boys and girls wey dey play for im streets.’”
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘If e dey marvelous for di eyes of di remnant of dis people for dem days, e suppose dey marvelous for my eyes too?’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Look, I go save my people from di east country, and from di west country;’”
“‘And I go bring dem, and dem go live inside Jerusalem; and dem go be my people, and I go be dem God, for truth and for righteousness.’”

“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Make una hands strong, una wey hear for dis days dis words from di mouth of di prophets, wey dey for di day wey dem lay di foundation of di house of di Lord of Armies, even di temple, so that dem go build am.’”

“‘Because before dem days, wages no dey for man, and no wages for animal; and no peace dey for di one wey dey go out or come in because of di adversary: because I set all men, everyone against im neighbor.’”
“‘But now I no go be to di remnant of dis people like di former days,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk.”
“‘Because seed of peace go dey; di vine go give im fruit, and di ground go give im increase, and di heavens go give dem dew; and I go make di remnant of dis people inherit all dis things.’”
“‘E go happen say, as una na curse among di nations, di house of Judah and di house of Israel, so I go save una, and una go be blessing. No fear. Make una hands strong.’”
“Because di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘As I think to do evil to una, when una papa dem provoke me to wrath,’ na so di Lord of Armies talk, ‘and I no repent;’”
“‘So again I don think for dis days to do good to Jerusalem and to di house of Judah. No fear.’”
“‘Dis na di things wey una go do: talk di truth, every man with im neighbor; do di judgment of truth and peace for una gates,’”
“‘And make nobody among una plan evil inside una hearts against im neighbor, and no love false oath: because all dis na things wey I hate,’ na so di Lord talk.”
Di word of di Lord of Armies come to me, and e talk say,

“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘Di fast of di fourth month, di fast of di fifth, di fast of di seventh, and di fast of di tenth, go be joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts to di house of Judah. So love truth and peace.’”
“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘E go still happen say peoples go come, even di people wey dey live for plenty cities.’”
“‘Di people wey dey live for one go come to another, and talk say: Make we go quick to entreat di favor of di Lord, and to seek di Lord of Armies. I go go too.’”
“‘Yes, plenty peoples and strong nations go come to seek di Lord of Armies for Jerusalem, and to entreat di favor of di Lord.’”

“Di Lord of Armies talk say, ‘For dem days, ten men go take hold, from all di languages of di nations, dem go take hold of di skirt of di one wey na Jew, and talk say: We go go with you, because we don hear say God dey with you.’”
Dis na revelation. Di Lord word dey against di land of Hadrach, and e go rest upon Damascus; because di eye of man and of all di tribes of Israel dey toward di Lord;
And Hamath too, wey dey border am; Tyre and Sidon, because dem very wise.
Tyre build stronghold for imself, and heap up silver like dust, and fine gold like di mud of di streets.
Look, Lord go dispossess am, and e go strike im power for di sea; and fire go devour am.
Ashkelon go see am, and fear. Gaza too go see am, and dey in great anguish; and Ekron, because im expectation go dey confounded. Di king go perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon no go dey inhabited.
Mixed people go live for Ashdod, and I go cut off di pride of di Philistines.
I go take away im blood from im mouth, and im abominations from between im teeth; and e too go be remnant for our God; and e go be like chieftain for Judah, and Ekron like Jebusite.
I go camp around my house against di army, so that nobody go pass through or return: and no oppressor go pass through dem again: because now I don see with my eyes.
Rejoice greatly, Zion daughter! Shout, Jerusalem daughter! Look, your king dey come to you! E righteous, and e get salvation; humble, and e dey ride donkey, even young donkey, di foal of donkey.

I go cut off di chariot from Ephraim, and di horse from Jerusalem; and di battle bow go cut off; and e go talk peace to di nations: and im dominion go dey from sea to sea, and from di River to di ends of di earth.
As for you too, because of di blood of your covenant, I don set free your prisoners from di pit wey no water dey inside.
Turn to di stronghold, una prisoners of hope; even today I dey declare say I go restore double to you.
Because I don bend Judah for me, I don fill di bow with Ephraim; and I go stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and I go make you like di sword of mighty man.
Dem go see di Lord over dem; and im arrow go come out like lightning; and di Lord God go blow di trumpet, and go move with whirlwinds of di south.
Di Lord of Armies go defend dem; and dem go devour, and go tread down di sling stones; and dem go drink, and make noise like with wine; and dem go dey full like bowls, like di corners of di altar.
Di Lord dem God go save dem for dat day like di flock of im people; because dem go be like di jewels of crown, lifted high over im land.
Because how great im goodness dey, and how great im beauty dey! Grain go make di young men flourish, and new wine di virgins.
Ask di Lord for rain for di spring time, even di Lord wey dey make storm clouds; and e dey give rain showers to dem, grass for everyone for di field.

Because di teraphim don talk iniquity, and di diviners don see lie; and dem don tell false dreams. Dem dey comfort for nothing. So di people dey wander like sheep. Dem dey suffer, because shepherd no dey.
My anger don kindle against di shepherds, and I go punish di male goats; because di Lord of Armies don visit im flock, di house of Judah, and e go make dem like im majestic horse for di battle.
From am go come out di cornerstone, from am di tent peg, from am di battle bow, from am every ruler together.
Dem go be like mighty men, wey dey tread down muddy streets for di battle; and dem go fight, because di Lord dey with dem; and di riders on horses go dey confounded.

I go strengthen di house of Judah, and I go save di house of Joseph, and I go bring dem back; because I get mercy on dem; and dem go be like say I no cast dem off; because I na di Lord dem God, and I go hear dem.
Ephraim go be like mighty man, and dem heart go rejoice like with wine; yes, dem pikin dem go see am, and rejoice; dem heart go glad for di Lord.
I go whistle for dem, and gather dem; because I don redeem dem; and dem go increase as dem don increase.
I go sow dem among di peoples; and dem go remember me for far countries; and dem go live with dem pikin dem, and go return.
I go bring dem again from di land of Egypt too, and gather dem from Assyria; and I go bring dem enter di land of Gilead and Lebanon; and enough room no go dey for dem.
E go pass through di sea of suffering, and e go strike di waves for di sea, and all di depths of di Nile go dry up; and di pride of Assyria go dey brought down, and di scepter of Egypt go leave.
“I go strengthen dem for di Lord; and dem go walk up and down for im name,” na so di Lord talk.
